column1: # Pass r8b hand rows: curated renames the evidence generator cannot derive (class X). Appended to pass-r8b.tsv.
# The three surface-named files c11 owns, and the v2 socket handlers they declare (Ghostty wrapper Surface names stay).
# In these tests `controller` is a TerminalController, not a Bonsplit controller: its renamed members follow
# tabID: Panel/surface UUID in journal, feed, roster, attention; Codable JournalOwner and JournalDraft CodingKeys are explicit strings ("tabID", "tab_id") so keys stay pinned
# tabIDs: Set/array of panel UUIDs (feed selection, in-flight answers, journal snapshots); panelIDs not present in these files
# visibleTabIDs: Visible feed rows keyed by panel id
# tabTTYName: TTY name of a panel (Workspace.panelTTYNames); argument label only
# tabC: Test local panel UUID (sibling of tabA/tabB), passed to LivePanel(tabID:)
# callerTabID: FeedRow.Flag field: panel that raised the flag; not Codable (Equatable struct), wire keys are explicit strings; EventEnvelope.callerPanelId is a different token
# tabInputSent: EventType case with explicit raw "panel.input_sent"; raw value unchanged
# tabTerminalDevice: Terminal device of the panel, argument label and local in mailbox foreground check
# tabDevice: Local tty dev_t of a panel (panelTTYNames loop in socketCallerTabId; mailbox foreground check)
# rawTab: Raw JSON value of the panel_id/tab_id key in drain decode; CLI/c11.swift rawTab is the raw value of the legacy --tab flag, which may be a workspace, so it is excluded
# expectedTab: Argument label of SendInputGuard.targetIsCurrent; callers pass resolved.terminalPanel
# tabInputPayload: Static builder for the panel input_sent event payload
# removeTab: FeedProjectionBridge.removeTab(workspaceID:tabID:), c11-owned; not the Bonsplit removeTab (bonsplit files excluded)
# validTabIDs: pruneWorkspace label, set of live panel ids
# tabsReady: Private flag set when startup session restore has registered panels; startupTabsReady is a separate token
# suppressedTab: Test local panel UUID passed as surfaceId
# retireTab: Private helper dropping a panel from feed journal state
# flaggedTab: Test local panel UUID passed as surfaceId
# toolTab: Test local: step.tab (panel) of the tool step
# tabJSON: Private static builder of one LivePanel row JSON; wire keys are strings
# tabInboxURL: Inbox directory of one panel (uuid-keyed); function name only
# sessionEndedOnLiveTab: Replay oracle helper comparing step.tab (panel); not a test function
# sameTab: Test local: rows with the same panel id in different workspaces
# notificationTabs: Test local array of panel UUIDs used as notification surfaceId
# notesByTab: AskDisplayCache notes grouped by panel id
# becameTab: flag: new pane collapsed into a panel of an existing area; wire value already 'panel'
# v2TabRef: returns surface/panel ref handle; wire keys are strings
# emitTabInputSent: event emitter for input sent to a panel; func name only
# browserTab: BrowserPanel-typed member/closure param; no existing browserPanel member in V2BrowserOffMainTarget
# tabIndex: enumerate index of a panel within an area; locals; JS tabindex in BrowserHandlers is a string and out of glob
# targetPaneForTab: local: area the new panel lands in
# browserTabs: local payload array of browser panels; plain browserPanels already exists in same func
# v2DebugTabStripScroll: debug seam for panel strip scroll (private func)
# v2DebugTabSheetOpen: debug seam for panel sheet (private func)
# v2DebugTabSheetHover: debug seam for panel sheet hover (private func)
# v2DebugTabSheetDetail: debug seam for panel sheet detail (private func)
# v2DebugTabRailOpen: debug seam for panel rail (private func)
# v2DebugOpenCommandPaletteRenameTabInput: debug seam: palette 'Rename Panel'; Notification.Name usage is a different token

# seedDragPasteboardTabTransfer: func name only; wire command seed_drag_pasteboard_tabtransfer and pasteboard type string unchanged
# callerTabEnv: reads C11_PANEL_ID (panel env) with hidden alias keys; static func name only
# tabRaw: locals holding a panel id string; no panelRaw in these files; CLI/c11.swift tabRaw intentionally excluded from globs (kept per brief)
# tabFlag: local for --panel flag value in feed command
# tabArgs: browser 'panel' subcommand args local; no collision
# tabNodes: local array of panel JSON nodes / YAML panel list nodes; panelNodes in c11.swift is in other funcs
# tabOpt: locals for --panel option in runTabAction/runRenameTab; no collision
# resolveTab: closure parameter/label resolving a panel handle in feed command
# recipientTabId: mailbox receipt recipient panel id param
# tabLine: summary line '1 panel / N panels' in area render
# resolveMailboxInboxTabId: resolves recipient panel UUID for mailbox inbox
# explicitTab: local: explicit --panel handle in input-state; .explicitPanel enum case is a distinct member access
# displayTabHandle: formats panel handle for display
# tabHandle: local in runTabAction; string key browser.profile.cli.tabHandle is a string, untouched
# journalTab: local: journal hook panel id
# formatTabHandle: formats panel handle from payload
